name: Loop
description: Iterate over array items, executing downstream nodes once per item. Supports distributed parallel execution via BullMQ.

fields.label: Input Array
fields.description: Field name containing the array to loop over.

fields.label: Batch Size
fields.description: Number of items to process per iteration (sequential mode only).

fields.label: Aggregate Output
fields.description: Accumulate results and emit all processed items when loop completes.

fields.label: Parallel Execution
fields.description: Distribute loop items across BullMQ workers for true distributed parallelism.

fields.label: Max Parallel Workers
fields.description: Maximum concurrent BullMQ workers (1-50). Higher values = faster but more resource usage.

fields.label: Continue On Error
fields.description: Continue processing remaining items even if some fail. Failed items include error info in results.

fields.label: Throttle (ms)
fields.description: Delay between loop iterations (sequential mode only).
